cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 85% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +1.31% · WTI +0.35% · Brent +1.11% · NatGas -1.73%. 85% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Refining & Downstream is doing the heavy lifting at +4.08%.

cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +4.08%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.14%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +9.77%
cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +9.77%, BE +9.48%, ARRY +6.77%, VLO +5.50%, TLN +4.85%. Laggards: FSLR -2.03%, NRG -1.61%, BWXT -1.30%, PEG -0.39%.
